description: This file defines a feature for deleting a follower relationship in a social media or user profile system. It contains a command object, a validator, and a request handler that processes the command to remove following relationships and return updated profile information.

classes.name: Delete
classes.description: Contains command, validator, and handler for deleting follower relationships.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the delete follower command by removing the follow relationship and returning the profile.
